name: Auth Your Agent
description: Let AI agents act for a person on websites, with the person's approval on their phone. Take over lets the owner drive a stuck agent's browser from their phone.

tools.name: check_login_wall
tools.description: Examine the current page and report whether it is blocked (password, CAPTCHA, 2FA, or sign-in approval).

tools.name: request_takeover
tools.description: Send a push notification to the user's phone. Blocks until they finish or 4 minutes expire. Returns done, cancelled, expired, or agent_left.

tools.name: wait_for_takeover
tools.description: If request_takeover timed out, call this to keep waiting.

tools.name: report_site
tools.description: Report a site where takeover did not work, so coverage can be improved.
